burundi.definition:
n. a landlocked republic in east central Africa on the northeastern shore of Lake Tanganyika
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Burundi or its people

burundian.definition: n. a native or inhabitant of Burundi
burundian.translation:
n. 布隆迪人
